snippet.title: [MMPR] - Puerto Vallarta Airport, Mexico - Trailer by FeelThere for Tower! Simulator 3
snippet.description:
Puerto Vallarta International Airport (IATA: PVR | ICAO: MMPR)

https://feelthere.com/shop/advertising/mmpr-puerto-vallarta-airport/

Situated north of downtown Puerto Vallarta, a few minutes from Marina Vallarta, México. MMPR serves as the main gateway to this stunning coastal destination, offering convenient access to the picturesque beaches and vibrant attractions of the region. As the fifth busiest airport in México for international passanger traffic, Puerto Vallarta Airport continues to grow in popularity, welcoming a significant number of passengers each year. The airport connects travelers to 52 destinations, including 13 domestic and 39 international, served by 24 airlines.
